text: 230 examples to learn from, 64 checks for tuning, 120 held out for the test. 8 labels.
Running live on Nebius Token Factory.
Base Nemotron 3 Nano got 88 of 120 held-out tickets right (73%).
Nemotron 3 Ultra scored 90% at $0.196 per 1,000 calls: the bar to chase.
Nemotron 3 Super found 5 failure types in 10 mistakes on the tuning checks.
Feedback misclassified as Product Question: Model confuses feature requests or general praise/feedback with specific product inquiries due to overlapping language about features.
Shipping misclassified as Billing: Model mistakes shipping-related queries (tracking, delivery) for billing issues when text mentions payment or charges alongside shipping context.
Feedback misclassified as Shipping: Model incorrectly labels positive feedback about fast shipping or packaging as a shipping issue instead of general feedback.
Product Question misclassified as Technical: Model treats general product capability questions (device compatibility, features) as technical support issues due to mention of devices or platforms.
Nemotron 3 Ultra wrote 135 cases; Nemotron 3 Super agreed with 128. 7 dropped.
Wrote a playbook for Nemotron 3 Nano: 5 house rules and 10 worked examples from the agreed cases.
Taught Nemotron 3 Nano got 99 of 120 right (83%), up from 73%.
Shipped. Taught beats base by 11 of 120 held-out tickets (73% to 83%). Endpoint: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B + playbook.
